source.notes: in.object is the player (serialization_world_objects' object format, class Player); in.character its shard Character (options, hair, plussed, shortcuts [index, object], spell bars [bar, index, spell], fill components [component, quantity], spellbook filters, gameplay options hex or null); in.seq the session's GameEventSequence. The Session has no AccessLevel set (Player) and the player no Session, so IsPlussed is Character.IsPlussed. out.hex is the message; out.seq_after the sequence after it. Enchantments are not included (their registry reads the world database's spells).
